subject: NebulaWorks marketplace addendum - chargeback, logging retention & invoice flow
messages:
From: Sam Walters <sam.walters@nebulaworks.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nebulaworks.com, legal@nebulaworks.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace addendum questions - chargeback and logging retention

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the walkthrough last week. Our legal and procurement teams reviewed the partner paper draft and surfaced two items we need clarified before we can proceed:

1) Chargeback / invoice pass-through: NebulaWorks requires clarity on how cloud marketplace refunds, cost adjustments or vendor chargebacks are routed. If cloud seller credits are issued to Redwood, we need a mechanism to pass-down or reconcile those amounts on our resale invoices (and a timeline for reversals).

2) Cloud logging retention: for audit purposes our compliance team wants the marketplace usage/billing logs retained for 90 days and accessible for audit. Your standard retention appears to be 30 days — can Redwood provide 90-day retention for marketplace traces and a way to export redacted logs to our S3 for audits?

Attached is the redline from our side (NW-Marketplace-Addendum-v1.docx). Can you confirm whether these two items are negotiable and provide a proposed path/owner for each item and a rough timeline?

Appreciate it — Sam

--
Sam Walters
Head of Cloud Partnerships | NebulaWorks
sam.walters@nebulaworks.com
(415) 555-0198
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Walters <sam.walters@nebulaworks.com>, procurement@nebulaworks.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Marketplace addendum questions - chargeback and logging retention

Team / Sam — looping in Ben (sales) and Laura (legal) to triage. Quick take:

- Chargebacks / invoice pass-through: we have two patterns we can offer depending on the partner model: (A) Pass-through reconciliation: Redwood forwards marketplace credits/adjustments as invoice credits on the next billing cycle (requires bookkeeping mapping and a monthly reconciliation window), or (B) Holdback/backstop: partner retains right to request a holdback reserve and Redwood issues credits after proof of chargeback event (slower, but limits short-term cash flow impact).

- Logging retention: operationally we can retain marketplace usage traces for 90 days and provide a timebound export (S3 link) for audit, but we need to confirm redaction and PII rules and whether NebulaWorks requires signed SOC2-level access for exported logs. This will likely need an ops runbook and a short SLA for retrieval requests.

I attached my triage notes with proposed owners and timelines (karthik_triage_notes.pdf). Laura — can you propose contract language for both options above? Ben — can you confirm commercial impact (cash flow / billing cycle) and which approach Nebula would prefer from a sales perspective?

Proposed timeline:
- 3 business days: legal language draft (Laura)
- 5 business days: ops confirm export procedure and retention costs
- 7 business days: consolidated redline back to Sam

Sam — would that timeline work for you?

Thanks,
Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Walters <sam.walters@nebulaworks.com>, legal@nebulaworks.com
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Marketplace addendum questions - chargeback and logging retention

Karthik / Ben / Sam — see inline and proposed clause snippets below. I reviewed NW-Marketplace-Addendum-v1.docx and have two main recommendations to manage Redwood risk while accommodating NebulaWorks' asks:

1) Chargeback / pass-through language (recommended primary approach = pass-through reconciliation):
- Add a monthly reconciliation procedure and a 60-day lookback for adjustments. Clause snippet: "If Marketplace Vendor issues credits or chargebacks that affect amounts billed to Redwood for transactions attributable to Reseller, Redwood will (i) notify Reseller within five (5) business days, and (ii) apply an invoice credit to the next invoice covering the affected billing period. Reseller shall provide reasonable documentation of the chargeback event within thirty (30) days."
- If NebulaWorks requires immediate cash remediation, we can consider a holdback arrangement as an alternative but that will require a commercial offset (discount or reserve) and Treasury sign-off.

2) Logging retention / audit export:
- We can commit to 90-day retention for marketplace usage and billing traces for purposes of billing audit. However we will limit exports to aggregated usage and non-PII billing traces unless a valid lawful request/audit scope is provided. Clause snippet: "Redwood will retain Marketplace usage and billing traces for ninety (90) days and, upon Reseller's reasonable request and subject to Redwood's security and data protection policies, provide an export of the relevant traces for billing audit purposes. Exported logs shall be redacted for PII in accordance with Redwood's data protection policies; Redwood will not provide raw customer messages or content."
- We should add an audit cooperation process and fees for out-of-scope requests (e.g., longer retention or forensic exports).

Operational asks for NebulaWorks: please confirm whether the 90-day aggregated traces satisfy your audit and whether you can accept redacted exports (no application payload). If you need raw message-level payloads for a regulated audit, we will need a separate data transfer agreement and security review.

I'll draft exact redline language and push NW-Marketplace-Addendum-v2.docx for Karthik to review.

Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sam Walters <sam.walters@nebulaworks.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, procurement@nebulaworks.com
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Marketplace addendum questions - chargeback and logging retention

Sam — thanks for the patience. Attached is NW-Marketplace-Addendum-v2.docx (Laura's redlines included) and a proposed mutual action plan. Summary of the changes and next steps:

1) Chargeback / invoice pass-through: agreed to support monthly pass-through reconciliation with a 60-day lookback and a 30-day evidence window for Reseller to submit supporting docs. If NebulaWorks requires an immediate cash remedy, we can discuss a limited holdback alternative but that will incur a commercial offset.

2) Logging retention & export: Redwood will retain billing/usage traces for 90 days and provide aggregated, redacted exports to a NebulaWorks S3 bucket for billing audits. We will not export raw customer content. For any requests beyond 90 days or requests for raw payloads, we will need a separate DTA and security review.

Proposed action plan / timeline:
- 48 hours: NebulaWorks confirms acceptance of the two bucketed options (pass-through + 90-day redacted export) or requests holdback alternative.
- 3 business days: Redwood delivers NW-Marketplace-Addendum-v2.docx via DocuSign for signature routing. (Link: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC-NEB-058)
- 5 business days: Ops to validate S3 export procedure and confirm retrieval SLA and encryption-at-rest details.

Attachments: NW-Marketplace-Addendum-v2.docx (redline), karthik_triage_notes.pdf

Sam — please confirm which path (pass-through reconciliation vs holdback) you'd prefer so we can finalize the redline and circulate for signature. If acceptable, I'll have Ben update the HubSpot record and set a renewal/ops onboarding meeting.

Thanks,
Karthik
